After that, I would like to generate another piece of music in E Major with a tempo of 90 beats per minute and a time signature of 3/4. Finally, generate another audio signal with a frequency of 300 Hz, an amplitude of 0.7, and a duration of 5 seconds."

Then call audio_generate with frequency 300, amplitude 0.7, duration 5.
